critical_mismatches: Multiple proper names corrupted or wrong (e.g. reference 'fromagère Juryn' transcribed as 'fourniture jurine'; 'Heineken' transcribed as 'ainecon'; 'Nancy' as 'mansi'; other names mangled).
Key personnel introductions and roles omitted or conflated (Annick Vincenti's intro and roles are largely missing/misattributed).

Accident/safety statistics and timelines are misreported or garbled (reference cites specific figures and history like '28 jours sans accident' and record '78 jours en 2016'; candidate gives different/unclear numbers and contradictory statements).
Hallucinated/incoherent insertions appear in the candidate (repeated English 'i was going...' and many filler repetitions) that are not in the reference.
Several factual details about origins/history and product names are altered (e.g. 'fromagère Montfaucon' / site history phrasing changed), affecting meaning.
rationale: The candidate preserves some high-level topics (site visit plan, safety, Saint Agur brand and packaging/RSE issues) but contains numerous material errors: several proper names and company/person identities are corrupted, key speaker introductions and roles are omitted or mixed up, accident statistics and other numeric facts are misreported, and there are clear hallucinated/incoherent insertions. These mistakes materially change factual content and reduce fidelity to the reference.
